column6: He @note{probably @wDN{Enlil}} told her, @wDN{Ninisina}, the great daughter of @wDN{An}, the great daughter-in-law, ……: @q[Enlil,Ninisina]{“That @wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}} should be your provider -- so let it be!”}

@wDN{Ninisina} paid attention to @wDN{Enlil's} utterance. She answered with humility: @q[Ninisina,Enlil]{“Father @wDN{Enlil}, god whose name is manifest, ……, @wDN{Enlil}; lord ……, your divine powers are the most ……, your instructions are the most precious. For the trustworthy shepherd ……, …… Lord @wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}} @gap{2 lines unclear} He has settled the people ……, he has made the Land feel content. You looked upon him with your life-giving gaze: now decree him a true fate!”}
@q{“Nunamnir, bestow upon prince @wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}} a long life of many days!”}

The Great Mountain @wDN{Enlil} paid attention to the words spoken by @wDN{Ninisina}. He blessed the king and decreed his fate: @q[Enlil,Lipit-Ectar]{“@wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}}, you whom I have called by name, shall be elevated among the people. May the living look to you as to their own fathers and mothers! May the strong one who cares for @wTN{E-kur}, the @fsux{ensi} of the august shrine, @wDN{Uta-ulu}, be your help on the battlefield! May he collect your enemies like swallows for you; may he spread them out like sheaves for you!”}
@wDN{Nunamnir}, the lord whose order cannot be altered, has made the name of prince @wRN{Lipit-@wDN{Eštar}} exalted among the numerous people.
@q[Enlil,]{“I, @wDN{Enlil}, am elevated in heaven, and am the lord of all the divine powers on earth. The good fate I have decreed to Lipit-@wDN{Eštar} is something which can never be changed!”}
